abstract: In this issue, Bayazid et al. (https://doi.org/10.1083/jcb.202603149) investigate Rac1 control of mechanosensing in postnatal maturation of proximal tubule epithelial cells. They show that Rac1 suppresses actomyosin activation, promotes ciliogenesis and flow sensing, and that loss of Rac1 promotes MCDK.
